items.lede: The Plymouth City Council was left with no choice but to physically disconnect the cameras after Flock failed to respond to its demands.
items.title: Police Chief physically unplugs Flock cameras after the company ignores contract cancellation

items.lede: While more cities are canceling their contracts with Flock Safety, just as many are discovering how difficult that can be in some instances.
